paite: Ginom a migenthei, mihau amukte kilawm lou gen leh mihai sang in ahoihzaw hi.
Huai lou in, kha theihna bei a a-om ding ahoih kei; huan kuapeuh akhe man-gang akhial nak hi.
Mihing haina in alampi ahihsia a; huan alungtang in TOUPA ahek hi.
Hausakna in lawmte tampi abehlap a; himahleh alawm a kipan migenthei khen in a-om.
Theihpih taklou gawt louh in a-om kei ding; huan kuapeuh zuaugen asuakta kei ding.
Mi tampi in misiam deihsakna angen ding ua; huan michih thilpiakte pia a ding in lawm ahi.
Migenthei unaute tengteng in amah ahua ua; amah a kipan bangchi a gamla in ahia alawmte apai uh! Thute in amau adelh a, himahleh apai khin uhi.
Kuapeuh pilna mu in akha a-it a; kuapeuh theihsiamna kem in hoih amu ding hi.
Theihpih taklou gawt louh in a-om kei ding a; kuapeuh zuaugen amangthang ding.
Mihai a ding in nuamtat akilawm kei a; lalte tung a sikha vaihawm akilawm kei sem hi.
Mihing ngentelna in amah ahehhaksak a; huan atatlekna paikan athupina ahi.
Kumpipa thangpaihna humpinelkai humham bang ahi; himahleh adeihsakna loupa tung a daitui bang ahi.
Tapa hai apa tuahsiatna ahi; huan zi hanhat a-intung keh gige ahi.
Inn leh hauhsaknate nu leh pate a kipan gouluah ahi; himahleh zi pil TOUPA a kipan ahi.
Thadahna nakpi a ihmutna ah apai a; huan mithadah in gilkial athuak ding.
Kuapeuh thupiak zui in akha akem a; himahleh kuapeuh alampite a pilvang lou asi ding.
Kuapeuh genthei hehpihna nei in TOUPA a ding in aleitawisak a, huan athil hoih hih amah adin nawn ding.
Lametna a-om lai in na tapa sawi in; huan akah ziak in na kha in khawlsan mawk ke'n.
Nakpitak a thangpaimi in gawtna athuak ding; amah na hutkhiakleh, huai tuh na hihkik nawn kul ding ahi ngal a.
Thupha za inla, hilhna sang in, na hinkhua nanung a na piltheihna ding in.
Mihing lungtang ah thugel tampi a-om a; himahleh TOUPA thuhilhna, huai mah adingh ding hi.
Mihing deihthusam amigitna tehna ahi; huan migenthei mizuauthei sang in ahoihzaw hi.
TOUPA kihtak hinna lam zotna ahi; huan kuapeuh huai nei lungkim in a-om gige ding; gilou veh in a-om kei ding hi.
Mithadah in kuang sung ah akhut aphum a, huchi in akam ah huai ahon tun nawn ngap kei hi.
Simmohhat sat in, mimawl in pilvandan asin ding; theihsiamna nei sal in, huchi in theihna atheisiam ding hi.
Kuapeuh apa tung a hiamgam a, anu delhmang, zumna omsak leh simmohna tun tapa ahi.
Theihna thute a kipan a lampial lel ding in, ka tapa, hilhna zak tawp in.
Theihpihmi phattuamna nei lou in vaihawmna asimmoh; huan migilou kam in thulimlouhna anawmvalh hi.
Muhsit hatmi a ding in vaihawmnate bawlkholhsa ahi, mihai nungzang a ding in vuaknate.
